ocr.notes: gist and most names readable; many character errors (Hallagher, Allon, Kaasas)

summary.suggested: The Daily Missouri Democrat reported that after police stopped the Allen-Gallagher fight on Tuesday, the backers agreed to hold it next Tuesday in Kansas for the same $1,500 stakes, with no excursion.

metadata.notes: Masthead: 'Daily Democrat, Thursday Morning, Nov. 3, 1870'. Before the 1875 merger, so not the Globe-Democrat.

facts.fact: The planned Allen-Gallagher prize fight was stopped by the interference of the St. Louis Chief of Police
Allen, Gallagher and their backers agreed at a saloon at Locust and Fifth streets to fight the following Tuesday in Kansas, stakes unchanged at $1,500 (Allen $1,000, Gallagher $500)
places: Saloon at Locust and Fifth streets, St. Louis

facts.fact: Allen's lawyer, Mr. Voullaire, denied a report that Allen meant to sue the city for false imprisonment

notes: The Kansas plan was a ruse; the fight took place near St. Louis on 1870-11-05 (see article 425).
